title: Was everyone outside last night
content: I ended up going to an event last night there were definitely over a hundred people. We were there until the morning and I remember not being able to leave and felt exhausted from the night. Things were dark and eerie the rooms felt like cabins all connected and I had an odd experience with a male and female who yelled at me to leave a room I was alone in. I kept loosing my friends for some reason and ended up looking for my shoes that were stolen… which made it harder to leave. Once it was morning everyone left on busses outside a parking lot… I have been trying to figure out if other people in my dreams are also dreaming and somehow we are in the same dimensional dreamscape or if I’m creating these people and they are not dreaming. Either way it feels like we are conscious of each other in a sort of otherworldly way.
